seoTitle: Automate Stripe Payment Notifications with Zapier
metaDescription: Route Stripe charge and payment events to Slack, Teams, or SMS with Zapier so your team knows about revenue events in real time.
intro: Checking a payment dashboard constantly to catch new sales or failed charges isn't efficient. This guide shows how to connect Stripe to Zapier so events like new charges, subscriptions, or failed payments automatically post to Slack, Microsoft Teams, or SMS with formatted, dynamic details.

steps.heading: Create a new Zap with Stripe as trigger
steps.body: Start a new Zap and select Stripe as your trigger application.

steps.heading: Authenticate your Stripe account
steps.body: Connect your Stripe account securely and grant the necessary webhook permissions.

steps.heading: Choose your trigger event
steps.body: Select the event you want to track, such as New Charge, New Subscription, or Failed Payment.

steps.heading: Test the trigger
steps.body: Fetch fresh test payload data from Stripe to safely map customer and currency variables.

steps.heading: Add your notification action
steps.body: Connect Slack, Teams, or SMS as the action step to route your payment alerts.

steps.heading: Format your message
steps.body: Map dynamic data tokens to format currency amounts and customer details, handling multiple currencies as needed.

faq.question: Can I get notified about failed payments too?
faq.answer: Yes, you can choose Failed Payment as a trigger event so your team is alerted to declined transactions in real time.

faq.question: Where can the notifications be sent?
faq.answer: The tutorial covers routing alerts to Slack, Microsoft Teams, or SMS depending on your team's preference.

faq.question: Does this handle different currencies?
faq.answer: Yes, best practices for handling multiple currencies are covered when formatting the payment amount.

faq.question: Can I include a link to the invoice in the alert?
faq.answer: Yes, dynamic data tokens like invoice links can be included when formatting your automated notification message.
